# Limited financial authority with a schedule of records

The donor ⟦PERSON|Mireva MacKell-Rusk⟧ appoints ⟦PERSON|Avelina O'Quenn-Curn⟧ to obtain the account records described in the schedule. The authority concerns inspection and reconciliation only. A proposed transfer of funds requires a further signed instruction identifying the destination and amount.

| Scheduled record | Account | Evidence to compare |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Household reserve statements | ⟦BANK|GB61 PURL 4062 8917 5304 28⟧ | Household receipts |
| Equipment reserve statements | ⟦BANK|GB37 REED 3095 7284 1603 52⟧ | Equipment invoices |

The attorney must keep the two accounts distinct when preparing the reconciliation. A missing receipt must be identified as missing rather than assigned to whichever account would produce the expected balance. The authority does not permit acceptance of a disputed charge merely because a statement records it as payable.

The replacement attorney is ⟦PERSON|Nerovan Pell-Rill⟧. The replacement may act only after the activation instruction in paragraph 4 has been supplied. Inclusion of the name in this schedule does not itself activate that appointment.

The originals may be inspected at ⟦ADDRESS|26 Celandine Lane, Durham⟧. They must remain with the signed authority and any approved correction to the schedule.

Donor's signature: ⟦PERSON|Mireva MacKell-Rusk⟧

Attorney's contact: ⟦PERSON|Avelina O'Quenn-Curn⟧; ⟦EMAIL|avelina.authority@purl-reed.invalid⟧; ⟦PHONE|+44 7700 900396⟧.
